name: Discerning Of Spirits
overview: The discerning of spirits involves a spiritual maturity that comes from the renewing of the mind and the exercise of one’s senses to distinguish good from evil. Scripture reveals that God’s Word is powerful and penetrating, able to judge the thoughts and intentions of the heart, enabling believers to test and approve God’s perfect will. This discernment grows through consistent use and spiritual growth, equipping believers to navigate spiritual realities with wisdom and clarity.
